note_gaps: code/md is a 7,298-character stub (README + minimal file listing) with no Julia solver source captured; all solver/algorithm detail is from the paper text only. No dexterous hand is demonstrated in this paper (systems tested: Atlas humanoid, Unitree A1, hopper, half-cheetah, ant, xArm 6 box-pushing).
contact_model: hard-contact nonlinear complementarity problem (NCP) with an exact nonlinear (second-order-cone) friction cone, avoiding pyramidal/linearized approximation, to avoid interpenetration and creep artifacts
solver: custom primal-dual interior-point solver (Algorithm 2), based on Mehrotra's predictor-corrector algorithm, extended for non-Euclidean quaternion variables, with cone-handling borrowed from CVXOPT; gradients via implicit differentiation (implicit function theorem) of the KKT/complementarity system, with central-path parameter kappa trading gradient smoothness for physical accuracy
solver_iterations: converges within 15 iterations for all three robots tested in the convergence study (Sec. V-A); default tolerances r_tol = kappa_tol = 1e-5
throughput: Intel Core i9-10885H, 32GB RAM, CPU only (no GPU support; described as future work). Table V, 1000-step forward+gradient wall-clock time at dt=0.01s: Humanoid - Dojo 1.750+/-0.135s vs MuJoCo 1.512+/-0.045s vs Drake 5.463+/-0.078s vs Brax 6.975+/-0.485s; Unitree A1 - Dojo 5.235+/-0.071s vs MuJoCo 1.114+/-0.007s vs Drake 3.870+/-0.024s vs Brax 11.064+/-0.521s; Franka Panda - Dojo 1.159+/-0.077s vs MuJoCo 0.335+/-0.001s vs Drake 2.352+/-0.055s vs Brax 10.954+/-0.395s; Skydio X2 - Dojo 0.807+/-0.003s vs MuJoCo 0.047+/-0.002s vs Drake 0.571+/-0.011s vs Brax 7.953+/-0.484s. MuJoCo is fastest on every system.
